entry.content:
Author: SeBe
Posted: Tue Nov 17, 2026 9:01 pm (GMT 0)

Congratulations on the Homebrew listing and the final update. A new SG-1000 game that also covers MSX and the other TMS9918 machines is a real treat. Thanks for putting up the free demo with the Halloween round — that's a nice way for people to try it.
